description: This file contains integration tests for verifying last repayment details on loans within the Fineract platform. It includes setup, creating clients, loan products, loans, making repayments, and assertions to ensure correct behavior of last repayment information when loans are closed or overpaid.

classes.name: LoanLastRepaymentDetailsTest
classes.description: This class contains integration tests that verify the correctness of last repayment details in loan accounts for different scenarios such as closed and overpaid loans. It sets up test data and assertions to ensure the system accurately reflects last repayment info.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured and sets up request and response specifications for the tests.

methods.name: loanLastRepaymentDetailsTestClosedLoan
methods.description: Tests that the last repayment details are correct for a loan that is fully repaid and closed.

methods.name: loanLastRepaymentDetailsTestOverpaidLoan
methods.description: Tests that the last repayment details are correctly updated when a loan is overpaid.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Creates a loan product with a specified delinquency bucket.

methods.name: createLoanAccount
methods.description: Creates and approves a loan account for a client with specified parameters.
